name: modules/design
description: The EDGE component vocabulary and the theme tokens every surface renders through.

floors.mutation-is-zero-because: Three enums and a resolver; `Typeface` has cases and no methods. `ThemeToken::in()` and `safeAsText()` are read arm by arm: `ThemeTokenTest` and `ThemeTest` here, `BrandPaletteParityTest` against the brand's own token file in both themes, and `TheAccentIsTheBrandsTest` and `TheThemeIsRegisteredAtBootTest` through the booted application. A mutant in a table arm is a colour spelled differently, and those four refuse one by name.
